records.literal_gloss: Give thanks to YHWH, for [he is] good, for to forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: Give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for [{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is] good, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: Give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} thanks, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is good; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: Thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is good! His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: Rendez grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, car [{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est] bon, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: Rendez grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est bon ; car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Remerciez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est bon ! Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana [ni] mwema, \q kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana ni mwema; \q upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu ni mwema! \q Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

es.L: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque [{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es] bueno, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es bueno; {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Den|Dad}} gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es bueno! Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

vi.L: Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là] thiện lành, \q vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.
vi.B: Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là thiện lành; \q tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.
vi.R: Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật tốt lành! \q Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하여라. 그분은 선하시니, \q 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하여라. 그분은 선하시다. \q 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하여라. 그분은 좋으신 분이다! \q 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: Rendam graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, porque [{{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é] bom, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: Rendam graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é bom; o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Agradeçam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é bom! O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አመስግኑ፤ መልካም ነውና፤ \q ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አመስግኑ፤ እርሱ መልካም ነው፤ \q ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} አመስግኑ፤ እርሱ መልካም ነው! \q ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का धन्यवाद करो, क्योंकि [वे] भले [हैं], क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का धन्यवाद करो, क्योंकि वे भले हैं; उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का धन्यवाद करो, क्योंकि वे भले हैं! उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।

ru.L: Благодарите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, потому что [{{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}] благ, потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Благодарите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} добр; {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.
ru.R: Благодарите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, потому что {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} добр! Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に感謝せよ。その方は良い方であり、その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に感謝せよ。その方は良い方、その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に感謝しよう。その方は良い方だから！その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: Дякуйте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, бо [{{deity_pronoun:він|Він}}] добрий, бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.
uk.B: Віддайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} подяку, бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} добрий; {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов триває навіки.
uk.R: Дякуйте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} добрий! Його вірна любов триває вічно.

decisions.choice: Book Five of the Psalms begins
decisions.reason: The Psalms are gathered into five books. Book Four closed with the blessing of 106:48; Book Five (Psalms 107-150) opens here and ends with the praise of Psalm 150. The psalm has no title.

decisions.choice: the song of the temple: good, love forever
decisions.reason: "He is good; his loyal love is forever" is the temple's great song of thanks (100:5; 106:1; 118:1; 136:1; 1 Chronicles 16:34; 2 Chronicles 5:13). Psalm 106 begins with the same words, and Psalm 107 answers its closing prayer to be gathered from the nations (106:47) with the gathering of verse 3.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith, God's commitment to his people that does not give up (5:8).

decisions.choice: for ... for: two reasons for thanks
decisions.reason: Both lines begin with the same word (ki): the LORD is good, and his love lasts.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

decisions.choice: the refrain worded as in Psalm 106:1: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B), "tình thương không hề thay đổi" (R)
decisions.reason: The same words for chesed run through the psalm (verses 8, 15, 21, 31, 43), as the terms note sets, so the refrain is heard each time. |

decisions.choice: The refrain as in Psalm 106:1: "그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다" (L), "...사랑이 영원하다" (B), "그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다" (R)
decisions.reason: One Korean form for the temple's refrain wherever it returns, with chesed as "한결같은 사랑" (L, B) and "변함없는 사랑" (R), as the published Psalm 23:6. The call to thanks is a plain-style command and God is spoken of with the honorific, as in Psalms 105-106.

decisions.choice: Rendam graças ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom; o seu amor leal dura para sempre (B), the refrain as 1 Chronicles 16:34
alternatives: a wording of this psalm's own
decisions.reason: The temple's refrain of thanks (m2) has the words of 1 Chronicles 16:34 in Portuguese at each level, as Psalm 118:1, 29 and 136 repeat them. Readable keeps "amor leal" here, as the Chronicles refrain does at every level, although the Psalms elsewhere say "amor fiel" at Readable (r-en-1); the refrain stays one sentence wherever it is sung.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 107
decisions.reason: Amharic has no deity_pronoun spans: the Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change. God is spoken of with the ordinary pronouns (እርሱ, አንተ) at every level.

decisions.choice: The refrain as Ezra 3:11 and 1 Chronicles 16:34: L «… መልካም ነውና፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።»; B, R «እርሱ መልካም ነው፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።»
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this verse is word for word that of 1 Chronicles 16:34, so its Amharic is kept, and the refrain reads the same wherever it comes back (106:1; 118:1, 29; 136).

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; God is spoken of with the honorific third person (वे, उनका) and addressed with the devotional तू.

decisions.choice: प्रभु for both YHWH and Adonai; only YHWH is in the divine_name span
decisions.reason: Book Five of the Psalms begins here. Hindi says प्रभु both for the name YHWH ("the LORD") and for the title Adonai ("Lord"); the divine_name setting tells them apart, since only the name is inside a setting span and can be shown as याहवे.

decisions.choice: wording of 1 Chronicles 16:34
decisions.reason: This refrain ("for he is good, his steadfast love is forever") is the temple song of 1 Chronicles 16:34, and Psalms 106, 107, 118 and 136 repeat it; Hindi keeps that verse's wording at each level, without its line break, since the English level here has none.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Chronicles 16:34
decisions.reason: The refrain is word for word the line of 1 Chronicles 16:34, so each level copies that verse's Russian (without its line break, as the English here is one line); Psalms 118 and 136 do the same.

decisions.choice: The refrain hodu laYHWH ki tov ki le'olam chasdo word for word as 1 Chronicles 16:34, without its line break: chesed "誠実" (L), "変わらぬいつくしみ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Book Five opens with the temple song (m1, m2); the Psalter keeps one Japanese form of this refrain (PSA-1 conventions), so Psalms 106, 107, 118 and 136 read alike. The English has no \q here, so neither does the Japanese.

source.text: יֹ֭אמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר גְּ֝אָלָ֗ם מִיַּד־צָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Let [the] redeemed of YHWH say [so], whom he has redeemed from [the] hand of [the] foe,

en.L: Let the redeemed of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} say [so], whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has redeemed from [the] hand of [the] foe,
en.B: Let those whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has bought back say it, those {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} freed from the grip of the enemy,
en.R: All the people whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has set free should say it! He rescued them from the power of their enemies.

fr.L: Qu’ils [le] disent, les rachetés {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rachetés de la main de l’adversaire,
fr.B: Qu’ils le disent, ceux que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a rachetés, ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a libérés de la poigne de l’ennemi,
fr.R: Tous ceux que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a libérés doivent le dire ! Il les a sauvés du pouvoir de leurs ennemis.

sw.L: Na waseme [hivyo] waliokombolewa na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q ambao amewakomboa kutoka mkononi mwa mtesi,
sw.B: Na waseme hivyo wale ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewakomboa, \q wale aliowaweka huru kutoka mikononi mwa adui,
sw.R: Watu wote ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amewaweka huru wanapaswa kusema hivyo! \q Aliwaokoa kutoka katika nguvu za adui zao.

es.L: Díganlo los redimidos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, a quienes {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha redimido de [la] mano del adversario,
es.B: Que lo digan aquellos a quienes {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha rescatado, los que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} liberó de las garras del enemigo,
es.R: ¡Todos los que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha liberado deben decirlo! Él los rescató del poder de sus enemigos.

vi.L: Nguyện những người được {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cứu chuộc nói [như vậy], \q những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cứu chuộc khỏi tay kẻ thù,
vi.B: Hãy để những người {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã chuộc về nói lên điều ấy, \q những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giải thoát khỏi nanh vuốt kẻ thù,
vi.R: Tất cả những người {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã giải thoát hãy nói lên điều đó! \q Ngài đã cứu họ khỏi quyền lực của kẻ thù.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 속량받은 이들은 [그렇게] 말하여라. \q 그분께서 그들을 대적의 손에서 속량하시고,
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 값을 치르고 되찾으신 이들은 그렇게 말하여라. \q 그분께서 그들을 원수의 손아귀에서 풀어 주시고,
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 자유롭게 하신 사람들은 모두 그렇게 말하여라! \q 그분께서 그들을 원수들의 손에서 구해 주셨다.

pt.L: Que digam [isso] os resgatados {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, os que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} resgatou da mão do adversário,
pt.B: Que o digam aqueles que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} resgatou, os que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} libertou das garras do inimigo,
pt.R: Todas as pessoas que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} libertou devem dizer isso! Ele as livrou do poder dos seus inimigos.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የቤዣቸው ይህን ይበሉ፤ \q ከባላጋራ እጅ የቤዣቸው፣
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የቤዣቸው ሰዎች ይህን ይናገሩ፤ \q ከጠላት እጅ ነጻ ያወጣቸው፣
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነጻ ያወጣቸው ሰዎች ሁሉ ይህን ይናገሩ! \q ከጠላቶቻቸው ኃይል ታደጋቸው።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के छुड़ाए हुए [ऐसा] कहें, जिन्हें उन्होंने शत्रु के हाथ से छुड़ाया है,
hi.B: जिन्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मोल लेकर छुड़ाया है, वे यह कहें, जिन्हें उन्होंने बैरी की पकड़ से आज़ाद किया,
hi.R: जिन सब लोगों को {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने छुड़ाया है, वे यह कहें! उन्होंने उन्हें उनके शत्रुओं की शक्ति से बचाया।

ru.L: Пусть скажут [так] искупленные {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, которых {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} искупил из руки врага,
ru.B: Пусть скажут это те, кого {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} выкупил, кого {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} освободил из рук врага,
ru.R: Пусть скажут это все, кого {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} освободил! Он спас их от власти врагов.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に贖われた者たちは[こう]言うように。その方は、仇の手から彼らを贖われた。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に贖い出された者たちは、こう言うように。その方は、仇の手から彼らを解き放たれた。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に救い出された人たちは、みな、こう言うべきだ。その方は、敵の力から彼らを助け出してくださった。

uk.L: Нехай скажуть [це] викуплені {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, яких {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} викупив з руки ворога,
uk.B: Нехай скажуть це ті, кого {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} викупив, ті, кого {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} звільнив з лещат ворога,
uk.R: Усі люди, яких {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} визволив, мають це сказати! Він урятував їх від влади їхніх ворогів.

decisions.choice: redeemed: bought back, set free
decisions.reason: The verb (ga'al) is what a near relative did in buying back family land or a relative sold as a slave (Leviticus 25:25, 48). God redeemed Israel from Egypt (Exodus 6:6) and from exile (Isaiah 43:1); "the redeemed of the LORD" are his people brought home (Isaiah 62:12).

decisions.choice: say so: say the words of verse 1
decisions.reason: What the redeemed are to say is the song of verse 1, "his loyal love is forever".

decisions.choice: the hand of the foe: the enemy's power
decisions.reason: The hand stands for power and control (31:16).

decisions.choice: those whom the LORD has bought back
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of buying back (m1) in everyday words.

decisions.choice: resgatar (L, B); libertar (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is buying back a relative or his land (m1). "Resgatar" keeps that picture of paying to set someone free in everyday Portuguese, where "redimir" is a church word; Readable says "libertou", as the English says "set free".

decisions.choice: redeem (gaʾal) as "ቤዠ" (L, B); Readable "ነጻ ያወጣቸው" (set free)
decisions.reason: The terms list keeps "ቤዠ" for gaʾal and "ዋጀ" for padah (ransom). Readable says plainly what the redeeming was, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: मोल लेकर छुड़ाना
decisions.reason: The verb is the redeeming of a relative, buying back (m1); Balanced keeps the picture of the price, as the English Balanced does, and Literal and Readable say छुड़ाना.

decisions.choice: выкупил
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the everyday sense of the verb, buying back, as the English does; Literal keeps the church word "искупленные".

decisions.choice: ga'al "贖う" (L), "贖い出す" / "解き放つ" (B), "救い出す" / "助け出す" (R)
decisions.reason: The redeemed are those bought back and set free (m1); the Psalter's padah/ga'al forms are kept (贖う at L). The third-person jussive 'let them say' is 〜ように at L and B, and R 'should say it' 〜べきだ, as in the refrains of this psalm.

decisions.choice: The run-on sentence of 107:2-3 is closed at the end of 107:2 and picked up in 107:3
decisions.reason: Japanese cannot hang the relative clause 'whom he redeemed … and gathered' across the verse break with the verb last; each verse becomes its own sentence.

source.text: וּֽמֵאֲרָצ֗וֹת קִ֫בְּצָ֥ם מִמִּזְרָ֥ח וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב מִצָּפ֥וֹן וּמִיָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: and from [the] lands he has gathered them, from east and from west, from north and from [the] sea.

en.L: and from the lands {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has gathered them, from east and from west, from north and from [the] sea.
en.B: and brought them in from other lands, from the east and the west, the north and the south.
en.R: He gathered them from far-off countries, from the east, the west, the north and the south.

fr.L: et des pays {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a rassemblés, de l’orient et de l’occident, du nord et de la mer.
fr.B: et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a ramenés des pays étrangers, de l’est et de l’ouest, du nord et du sud.
fr.R: Il les a rassemblés de pays lointains, de l’est, de l’ouest, du nord et du sud.

sw.L: na kutoka katika nchi amewakusanya, \q kutoka mashariki na kutoka magharibi, \q kutoka kaskazini na kutoka baharini.
sw.B: na kuwaleta kutoka nchi nyingine, \q kutoka mashariki na magharibi, \q kaskazini na kusini.
sw.R: Aliwakusanya kutoka nchi za mbali, \q kutoka mashariki, \q magharibi, kaskazini na kusini.

es.L: y de las tierras {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los ha reunido, del oriente y del occidente, del norte y del mar.
es.B: y los trajo de otras tierras, del oriente y del occidente, del norte y del sur.
es.R: Los reunió de países lejanos, del este, del oeste, del norte y del sur.

vi.L: và từ các xứ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nhóm họ lại, \q từ phương đông và từ phương tây, \q từ phương bắc và từ [phía] biển.
vi.B: và đã đem họ về từ các xứ khác, \q từ phương đông và phương tây, \q phương bắc và phương nam.
vi.R: Ngài đã nhóm họ lại từ những xứ xa xôi, \q từ phương đông, phương tây, \q phương bắc và phương nam.

ko.L: 여러 땅에서, 동쪽과 서쪽에서, \q 북쪽과 바다 쪽에서 \q 그들을 모으셨다.
ko.B: 다른 땅들에서, 동쪽과 서쪽, \q 북쪽과 남쪽에서 \q 그들을 모아 들이셨다.
ko.R: 그분께서 먼 나라들에서, \q 동쪽과 서쪽과 북쪽과 남쪽에서 \q 그들을 모으셨다.

pt.L: e das terras {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os ajuntou, do oriente e do ocidente, do norte e do mar.
pt.B: e os trouxe de volta de outras terras, do oriente e do ocidente, do norte e do sul.
pt.R: Ele os reuniu de países distantes, do leste, do oeste, do norte e do sul.

am.L: ከየአገሩም የሰበሰባቸው፣ \q ከምሥራቅና ከምዕራብ፣ \q ከሰሜንና ከባሕር።
am.B: ከልዩ ልዩ አገሮች፣ \q ከምሥራቅና ከምዕራብ፣ \q ከሰሜንና ከደቡብ የሰበሰባቸው።
am.R: ከሩቅ አገሮች፣ ከምሥራቅ፣ \q ከምዕራብ፣ \q ከሰሜንና ከደቡብ ሰበሰባቸው።

hi.L: और देशों से उन्होंने उन्हें इकट्ठा किया है, पूरब से और पश्चिम से, उत्तर से और समुद्र से।
hi.B: और उन्हें दूसरे देशों से ले आए हैं, पूरब और पश्चिम से, उत्तर और दक्षिण से।
hi.R: उन्होंने उन्हें दूर-दूर के देशों से इकट्ठा किया, पूरब से, पश्चिम से, उत्तर से और दक्षिण से।

ru.L: и из земель {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} собрал их, с востока и с запада, с севера и с моря.
ru.B: и собрал из чужих земель, с востока и запада, с севера и юга.
ru.R: Он собрал их из далёких стран: с востока и запада, с севера и юга.

ja.L: また、もろもろの地から彼らを集められた。東から、西から、北から、海から。
ja.B: また、ほかの国々から彼らを連れ帰られた。東から、西から、北から、南から。
ja.R: その方は、遠い国々から彼らを集めてくださった。東から、西から、北から、南から。

uk.L: і з країн {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зібрав їх, зі сходу і з заходу, з півночі і від моря.
uk.B: і привів їх з інших країн, зі сходу й заходу, з півночі й півдня.
uk.R: Він зібрав їх із далеких країн, зі сходу, заходу, півночі й півдня.

decisions.choice: gathered from the lands: the return from exile
decisions.reason: God had promised to gather his scattered people from every direction (Deuteronomy 30:3-4; Isaiah 43:5-6). The psalm thanks him for bringing them home.

decisions.choice: the sea: here the south
alternatives: the south (reading yamin, a word very like it)
decisions.reason: "The sea" usually means the west, but the west is already named. Here it probably means the south, perhaps the Red Sea; one small change of letters gives the word for "south".

decisions.choice: the south
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the direction that completes the four (m2); Literal keeps "sea".

decisions.choice: brought them in (B); He gathered them (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced continues the sentence of verse 2; Readable begins a new sentence and names who gathered them.

decisions.choice: del sur
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the fourth direction "the sea". Literal keeps "del mar"; Balanced and Readable say "del sur", as the English does, so that the four directions read as a whole.

decisions.choice: miyyam "海から" (L), "南から" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The sea is read here as the south, completing the four directions (m2, uncertain, with the English footnote); L keeps the Hebrew word.

source.text: תָּע֣וּ בַ֭מִּדְבָּר בִּישִׁימ֣וֹן דָּ֑רֶךְ עִ֥יר מ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב לֹ֣א מָצָֽאוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: They wandered in the wilderness, in a wasteland [of a] way; a city of dwelling not they found.

en.L: They wandered in the wilderness, on a desolate way; a city [to] dwell [in] they did not find.
en.B: Some strayed through the wilderness, along a barren track, and found no town to live in.
en.R: Some people were lost in the desert. They traveled through empty land and could not find any town to live in.

fr.L: Ils ont erré dans le désert, sur un chemin désolé ; une ville [où] habiter, ils n’en ont pas trouvé.
fr.B: Certains se sont égarés dans le désert, sur une piste aride, sans trouver de ville où habiter.
fr.R: Des gens s’étaient perdus dans le désert. Ils ont traversé des terres vides et n’ont trouvé aucune ville où vivre.

sw.L: Walitangatanga jangwani, katika njia ya ukiwa; \q mji wa kukaa hawakuupata.
sw.B: Wengine walipotea nyikani, katika njia ya ukame, \q wasipate mji wa kuishi.
sw.R: Watu wengine walipotea jangwani. \q Walisafiri katika nchi tupu wasiweze kupata mji wowote wa kuishi.

es.L: Anduvieron errantes por el desierto, por un camino desolado; ciudad [donde] habitar no hallaron.
es.B: Algunos vagaron por el desierto, por una senda yerma, y no encontraron pueblo donde vivir.
es.R: Algunos estaban perdidos en el desierto. Viajaban por tierras vacías y no encontraban ningún pueblo donde vivir.

vi.L: Họ đã lang thang trong đồng hoang, trên một con đường hoang vắng; \q một thành [để] ở họ đã không tìm thấy.
vi.B: Có những người lạc lối trong đồng hoang, trên con đường khô cằn, \q và không tìm được thành nào để ở.
vi.R: Có những người bị lạc trong sa mạc. \q Họ đi qua vùng đất trống trải và không tìm được thành nào để sống.

ko.L: 그들은 광야에서, 황량한 길에서 헤매었고, \q 살 성읍을 찾지 못하였다.
ko.B: 어떤 이들은 광야에서, 메마른 길을 따라 헤매며 \q 살 만한 성읍을 찾지 못했다.
ko.R: 어떤 사람들은 사막에서 길을 잃었다. \q 텅 빈 땅을 지나며 살 만한 마을을 하나도 찾지 못했다.

pt.L: Vaguearam no deserto, por um caminho desolado; uma cidade [para] morar não encontraram.
pt.B: Uns andaram perdidos pelo deserto, por uma trilha árida, e não acharam cidade onde morar.
pt.R: Algumas pessoas estavam perdidas no deserto. Andavam por uma terra vazia e não conseguiam achar nenhuma cidade para morar.

am.L: በምድረ በዳ፣ በባድማ መንገድ ተቅበዘበዙ፤ \q የሚኖሩባትን ከተማ አላገኙም።
am.B: አንዳንዶቹ በምድረ በዳ፣ ጠፍ በሆነ መንገድ ተቅበዘበዙ፤ \q የሚኖሩበትንም ከተማ አላገኙም።
am.R: አንዳንድ ሰዎች በምድረ በዳ ጠፍተው ነበር። ባዶ በሆነ ምድር ተጓዙ፤ \q የሚኖሩበትንም ከተማ ማግኘት አልቻሉም።

hi.L: वे निर्जन प्रदेश में, उजाड़ मार्ग पर भटकते रहे; बसने के लिए [कोई] नगर उन्हें न मिला।
hi.B: कुछ लोग निर्जन प्रदेश में एक सूने रास्ते पर भटकते रहे, और उन्हें रहने के लिए कोई नगर न मिला।
hi.R: कुछ लोग रेगिस्तान में खो गए थे। वे सुनसान इलाक़े में से होकर चलते रहे, पर उन्हें रहने के लिए कोई बस्ती न मिली।

ru.L: Они блуждали в пустыне, по пустынной дороге; города [для] жилья они не нашли.
ru.B: Одни скитались по пустыне, по безлюдной дороге, и не находили города, где можно жить.
ru.R: Одни люди заблудились в пустыне. Они шли по пустой земле и не могли найти ни одного города, где можно было бы поселиться.

ja.L: 彼らは荒れ野で、荒れ地の道をさまよい、住むべき町を見いださなかった。
ja.B: ある者たちは荒れ野をさまよい、荒れ果てた道をたどったが、住むことのできる町を見つけなかった。
ja.R: ある人たちは、砂漠で道に迷った。何もない土地を旅したが、住むことのできる町は見つからなかった。

uk.L: Вони блукали в пустелі, безлюдною дорогою; міста, [щоб] жити [в ньому], вони не знайшли.
uk.B: Одні блукали пустелею, голим шляхом, і не знаходили міста, де можна жити.
uk.R: Деякі люди заблукали в пустелі. Вони йшли порожньою землею і не могли знайти міста, щоб там жити.

decisions.choice: four pictures of people in trouble
decisions.reason: The psalm draws four groups who cried to the LORD and were rescued: travelers lost in the desert (4-9), prisoners (10-16), the sick (17-22) and sailors in a storm (23-32). They may be four kinds of people, or four pictures of Israel in exile and its return.

decisions.choice: a wasteland of a way: a desolate track
alternatives: in the wasteland they found no way to a city
decisions.reason: The words "in a wasteland, a way" are terse. They describe the road the travelers were on, or they belong with the next line: they found no way to a city.

decisions.choice: a city of dwelling: a place to settle
decisions.reason: A town with people in it, where travelers could find food, water and a home.

decisions.choice: Some
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable mark the start of the first group with "Some" (m1).

decisions.choice: Uns (B); Algumas pessoas (R)
decisions.reason: As the English "Some" (r-en-1), Balanced and Readable mark the first of the four groups (m1); the same words open each group in verses 10, 17 and 23.

decisions.choice: Одни
decisions.reason: The English "Some" opens each of the four pictures (verses 4, 10, 17, 23); Russian "Одни" does the same at each one.

decisions.choice: "ある者たちは" (B), "ある人たちは" (R) for the first of the four groups
decisions.reason: The psalm draws four pictures of people in trouble (m1, uncertain); as the English B and R, Japanese supplies 'some' at the head of each picture (107:4, 10, 17, 23). midbar 荒れ野 (L, B), 砂漠 (R), as the Psalter has it.

source.text: רְעֵבִ֥ים גַּם־צְמֵאִ֑ים נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בָּהֶ֥ם תִּתְעַטָּֽף׃

records.literal_gloss: Hungry, also thirsty, their soul in them was fainting.

en.L: Hungry, thirsty too, their soul was fainting within them.
en.B: Starving and parched, they felt their life draining out of them.
en.R: They had no food and no water, and they were close to dying.

fr.L: Affamés, assoiffés aussi, leur âme défaillait en eux.
fr.B: Affamés et assoiffés, ils sentaient leur vie s’en aller.
fr.R: Ils n’avaient plus ni nourriture ni eau, et ils étaient près de mourir.

sw.L: Wenye njaa, tena wenye kiu, \q nafsi zao zilizimia ndani yao.
sw.B: Wakiwa na njaa kali na kiu, \q waliona uhai wao ukiwaishia.
sw.R: Hawakuwa na chakula \q wala maji, nao walikuwa karibu kufa.

es.L: Hambrientos, sedientos también, su alma desfallecía dentro de ellos.
es.B: Muertos de hambre y de sed, sentían que la vida se les escapaba.
es.R: No tenían comida ni agua, y estaban a punto de morir.

vi.L: Đói, cũng khát nữa, \q linh hồn họ hao mòn trong họ.
vi.B: Đói lả và khát khô, \q họ cảm thấy sự sống đang cạn dần trong mình.
vi.R: Họ không có thức ăn \q và nước uống, và họ gần chết.

ko.L: 주리고 목마르기도 하여, \q 그들 안에서 그들의 목숨이 약해져 갔다.
ko.B: 굶주리고 목이 타서, \q 그들의 목숨이 꺼져 가는 것 같았다.
ko.R: 먹을 것도 마실 물도 없어서 \q 그들은 거의 죽게 되었다.

pt.L: Famintos, sedentos também, a sua alma desfalecia dentro deles.
pt.B: Famintos e sedentos, sentiam a vida se esvair de dentro deles.
pt.R: Não tinham comida nem água, e estavam quase morrendo.

am.L: ተርበው፣ ደግሞም ተጠምተው፣ \q ነፍሳቸው በውስጣቸው ትዝል ነበር።
am.B: ተርበውና ተጠምተው ሕይወታቸው \q ከውስጣቸው እያለቀች እንደ ሆነ ተሰማቸው።
am.R: ምግብም ውኃም አልነበራቸውም፤ \q ለሞትም ተቃርበው ነበር።

hi.L: भूखे, प्यासे भी, उनका प्राण उनके भीतर मूर्च्छित हो रहा था।
hi.B: भूख और प्यास से बेहाल, उन्हें लगा कि उनका जीवन उनमें से निकलता जा रहा है।
hi.R: उनके पास न खाना था न पानी, और वे मरने पर थे।

ru.L: Голодные, жаждущие тоже, душа их изнемогала в них.
ru.B: Голодные и измученные жаждой, они чувствовали, как из них уходит жизнь.
ru.R: У них не было ни еды, ни воды, и они были близки к смерти.

ja.L: 飢え、また渇き、彼らの魂は彼らの内で衰え果てていた。
ja.B: 飢えと渇きに苦しみ、彼らの命は尽きかけていた。
ja.R: 食べ物も水もなく、彼らは今にも死にそうだった。

uk.L: Голодні, спраглі теж — їхня душа знемагала в них.
uk.B: Голодні й спраглі, вони відчували, як із них витікає життя.
uk.R: Вони не мали ні їжі, ні води, і були близькі до смерті.

decisions.choice: soul: life, the living self
decisions.reason: The word (nefesh) is the self as a living, breathing being; for it to faint is to come near death.

decisions.choice: was fainting: growing weak
decisions.reason: The verb ('ataf) is used of a spirit growing faint in 77:4 and 142:4.

decisions.choice: their life draining out of them (B); close to dying (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the picture means (m1).

decisions.choice: "목숨" (life) for nefesh at Literal in verses 5 and 9, not "영혼"
decisions.reason: Here the word (nefesh) is the living self that hungers, thirsts and grows faint (meaning decisions). Korean "영혼" would suggest the spirit and a spiritual hunger, which is not the sense, so Literal says "목숨", the word for one's life as a living being. In verse 18, where the word is the appetite, Literal says "입맛".

decisions.choice: nafsham "彼らの魂" (L), "彼らの命" (B); R "今にも死にそうだった"
decisions.reason: Soul here is life, the living self (m1), growing weak (m2); nefesh is 魂 at L by the Psalter's rule, B and R give the sense as the English.

source.text: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֽוּקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יַצִּילֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they cried out to YHWH in the distress [that was] to them; from their troubles he delivered them.

en.L: Then they cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in their distress; from their troubles {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} delivered them.
en.B: In their distress they called out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rescued them from their troubles.
en.R: In their trouble they cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rescued them from their suffering.

fr.L: Alors ils ont crié {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} dans leur détresse ; de leurs angoisses {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a délivrés.
fr.B: Dans leur détresse, ils ont appelé {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au secours, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a délivrés de leurs angoisses.
fr.R: Dans leur malheur, ils ont crié {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les aide, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a sauvés de leurs souffrances.

sw.L: Ndipo wakamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika dhiki yao; \q kutoka katika taabu zao akawanasua.
sw.B: Katika dhiki yao walimlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akawanasua katika taabu zao.
sw.R: Katika taabu yao walimlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awasaidie, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akawaokoa katika mateso yao.

es.L: Entonces clamaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en su angustia; de sus aflicciones {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los libró.
es.B: En su angustia clamaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los rescató de sus aflicciones.
es.R: En su aflicción clamaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} pidiendo ayuda, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los rescató de su sufrimiento.

vi.L: Bấy giờ họ kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong cơn khốn quẫn của họ; \q khỏi những nỗi gian nan của họ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giải cứu họ.
vi.B: Trong cơn khốn quẫn, họ kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu họ khỏi những nỗi gian nan.
vi.R: Trong lúc khốn khó, họ kêu cứu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giải cứu họ khỏi cảnh khổ.

ko.L: 그때에 그들이 고난 가운데서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖으니, \q 그분께서 그들의 곤경에서 그들을 건지셨다.
ko.B: 그들이 고난 가운데서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖자, \q 그분께서 곤경에서 그들을 건져 주셨다.
ko.R: 괴로울 때 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 도와 달라고 부르짖자, \q 그분께서 고통에서 그들을 건져 주셨다.

pt.L: Então clamaram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} na sua angústia; das suas aflições {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os livrou.
pt.B: Na sua angústia clamaram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os livrou das suas aflições.
pt.R: No meio da aflição, eles clamaram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} pedindo socorro, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os livrou do sofrimento.

am.L: በጭንቀታቸውም ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጮኹ፤ \q ከመከራቸውም ታደጋቸው።
am.B: በጭንቀታቸው ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ተጣሩ፤ \q እርሱም ከመከራቸው ታደጋቸው።
am.R: በችግራቸው ጊዜ እርዳታ ለማግኘት ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጮኹ፤ \q እርሱም ከሥቃያቸው ታደጋቸው።

hi.L: तब उन्होंने अपने संकट में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की दोहाई दी; उनकी विपत्तियों से उन्होंने उन्हें छुड़ाया।
hi.B: अपने संकट में उन्होंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को पुकारा, और उन्होंने उन्हें उनकी विपत्तियों से छुड़ा लिया।
hi.R: अपनी मुसीबत में उन्होंने सहायता के लिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को पुकारा, और उन्होंने उन्हें उनके दुःखों से छुड़ा लिया।

ru.L: Тогда они воззвали к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} в своей беде; из их бедствий {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} избавил их.
ru.B: В беде они воззвали к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} избавил их от бедствий.
ru.R: В беде они стали звать {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} на помощь, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} избавил их от страданий.

ja.L: そのとき彼らは、自分たちの苦難の中で{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に叫び求めた。その方は彼らを、その苦悩から救い出された。
ja.B: 苦難の中で彼らが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に呼び求めると、その方は彼らを苦しみから救い出された。
ja.R: 困り果てた彼らは、助けを求めて{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に叫んだ。すると、その方は彼らを苦しみから救い出してくださった。

uk.L: Тоді вони закликали до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} у своїй скруті; з їхніх бід {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} визволив їх.
uk.B: У своїй скруті вони кликали до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} урятував їх з їхніх бід.
uk.R: У своїй біді вони кликали {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} на допомогу, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} урятував їх від їхніх страждань.

decisions.choice: the first refrain
decisions.reason: This line comes four times (verses 6, 13, 19, 28), once in each picture of people in trouble, and each time only the verb of rescue changes. Each time the second refrain follows two verses later (8, 15, 21, 31).

decisions.choice: cried out: cried for help
decisions.reason: The verb (tsa'aq) is the cry of people in need, like Israel's cry in Egypt (Exodus 3:7).

decisions.choice: delivered: snatched away
decisions.reason: The verb (natsal, causative) is to pull someone out of danger. Each refrain has its own verb: delivered (6), saved (13, 19), brought out (28).

decisions.choice: in their distress ... from their troubles
alternatives: they cried out ... in their trouble, and he ... them from their distress
decisions.reason: The refrain keeps the same wording each time; Balanced and Readable put "in their distress" first, where it is heard most.

decisions.choice: one wording for the refrain of verses 6, 13, 19 and 28 at each level, changing only the verb as the Hebrew does
decisions.reason: The psalm's four pictures each end with the same cry; keeping the same Vietnamese words lets the reader hear the pattern, as the English does. |

decisions.choice: The first refrain (verses 6, 13, 19, 28) has one Korean wording, changing only the verb of rescue: "건지셨다" (6), "구원하셨다" (13, 19), "이끌어 내셨다" (28)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew repeats the line word for word but for the verb (meaning decision), and Korean keeps the repetition so the reader hears it.

decisions.choice: clamaram ... na sua angústia ... das suas aflições (L, B); No meio da aflição ... do sofrimento (R)
decisions.reason: The first refrain (m1) keeps one wording at each level in verses 6, 13, 19 and 28, with only the verb of rescue changing: "livrou" (6), "salvou" (13, 19), "tirou" (28). "Clamar" is the cry for help of Israel in Egypt (m2).

decisions.choice: The first refrain (6, 13, 19, 28) has one wording; only its last verb changes, as the Hebrew does: "ታደጋቸው" (6), "አዳናቸው" (13, 19), "አወጣቸው" (28)
decisions.reason: The refrain is meant to be heard as the same words each time; distress (tsar) is "ጭንቀት" and troubles (metsuqot) "መከራ" (R "ችግር", "ሥቃይ").

decisions.choice: one wording for the refrain (verses 6, 13, 19, 28)
decisions.reason: The refrain keeps the same Hindi each time and changes only the last verb as the Hebrew does (छुड़ाना, बचाना, निकालना). The honorific उन्होंने for God sounds like the people's plural; "उन्होंने उन्हें" (he ... them) shows that the one who rescues is not the people who cried out.

decisions.choice: воззвали (B); стали звать на помощь (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is a cry for help; Readable says so. The refrain keeps one wording in verses 6, 13, 19 and 28, changing only the last verb as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: First refrain (107:6, 13, 19, 28) in one form: tsa'aq/za'aq "叫び求めた" (L), "呼び求める" (B), "助けを求めて…叫んだ" (R); the last verb varies with the Hebrew: hitsil "救い出された", hoshia' "お救いになった", hotsi' "連れ出された"
decisions.reason: The refrain is repeated with one changed verb each time (m1); Japanese keeps the frame word for word and changes only that verb. お救いになった is used rather than 救われた, which reads as a passive.

source.text: וַ֭יַּֽדְרִיכֵם בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֑ה לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת אֶל־עִ֥יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃

records.literal_gloss: And he led them by a straight way to go to a city of dwelling.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} led them by a straight way, to go to a city [to] dwell [in].
en.B: He guided them on a level road until they came to a town to live in.
en.R: He led them straight to a town where they could make their homes.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a conduits par un chemin droit, pour aller vers une ville [où] habiter.
fr.B: Il les a guidés sur une route bien droite jusqu’à une ville où habiter.
fr.R: Il les a menés tout droit vers une ville où ils ont pu s’installer.

sw.L: Naye akawaongoza katika njia iliyonyooka, \q ili waende kwenye mji wa kukaa.
sw.B: Aliwaongoza katika njia tambarare \q mpaka wakafika kwenye mji wa kuishi.
sw.R: Aliwaongoza moja kwa moja mpaka mji ambamo wangeweza kujenga makao yao.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los condujo por camino recto, para ir a una ciudad [donde] habitar.
es.B: Los guio por un camino llano hasta que llegaron a un pueblo donde vivir.
es.R: Los llevó directamente a un pueblo donde pudieran tener su hogar.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dẫn họ theo con đường thẳng, \q để đi đến một thành [để] ở.
vi.B: Ngài dẫn họ đi trên con đường bằng phẳng \q cho đến khi họ tới một thành để ở.
vi.R: Ngài dẫn họ đi thẳng đến một thành nơi họ có thể lập nhà cửa.

ko.L: 그리고 그분께서 그들을 곧은 길로 이끄셔서 \q 살 성읍으로 가게 하셨다.
ko.B: 그분께서 그들을 평탄한 길로 인도하셔서, \q 마침내 살 만한 성읍에 이르게 하셨다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 그들을 곧장 그들이 집을 짓고 살 수 있는 마을로 이끄셨다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os guiou por um caminho reto, para irem a uma cidade [para] morar.
pt.B: Ele os conduziu por uma estrada plana até chegarem a uma cidade onde morar.
pt.R: Ele os levou direto para uma cidade onde podiam fazer o seu lar.

am.L: በቀና መንገድም መራቸው፤ \q ወደሚኖሩባት ከተማ ይሄዱ ዘንድ።
am.B: ወደሚኖሩበት ከተማ እስኪደርሱ ድረስ \q በቀና መንገድ መራቸው።
am.R: ቤታቸውን ሠርተው ወደሚኖሩበት ከተማ በቀጥታ መራቸው።

hi.L: और वे उन्हें सीधे मार्ग से ले चले, कि वे बसने के [एक] नगर को जाएँ।
hi.B: उन्होंने उन्हें समतल मार्ग पर चलाया, यहाँ तक कि वे रहने के लिए एक नगर में पहुँच गए।
hi.R: वे उन्हें सीधे एक ऐसे नगर में ले गए जहाँ वे अपना घर बना सकते थे।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} повёл их прямым путём, чтобы идти к городу [для] жилья.
ru.B: Он вёл их ровной дорогой, пока они не пришли в город, где можно жить.
ru.R: Он привёл их прямо в город, где они смогли поселиться.

ja.L: その方は彼らをまっすぐな道に歩ませ、住むべき町へ行かせられた。
ja.B: その方は彼らを平らな道に導き、住むことのできる町にたどり着かせてくださった。
ja.R: その方は彼らを、まっすぐに、家を建てて住むことのできる町へ連れて行ってくださった。

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} повів їх прямою дорогою, щоб дійти до міста, [щоб] жити [в ньому].
uk.B: Він вів їх рівною дорогою, аж поки вони не прийшли до міста, де можна жити.
uk.R: Він повів їх просто до міста, де вони могли оселитися.

decisions.choice: straight: direct and level
decisions.reason: The word (yashar) means straight or level. It answers the wandering of verse 4: the lost are led by the shortest road to the town they could not find.

decisions.choice: led: as in the wilderness
decisions.reason: God led Israel through the wilderness (Deuteronomy 8:2) and promised to lead the exiles home on a level road (Isaiah 40:3-4; Jeremiah 31:9).

source.text: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Let them give thanks to YHWH [for] his loyal love, and his wonders to [the] children of humankind.

en.L: Let them give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [for] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love, and [for] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wonders to the children of humankind.
en.B: Let them give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} thanks for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love and for the wonders {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} works for humankind.
en.R: They should thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful love and for the amazing things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does for people.

fr.L: Qu’ils rendent grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} [pour] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal, et [pour] {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} merveilles envers les {{gender:enfants des humains|fils des hommes}}.
fr.B: Qu’ils rendent grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle et pour les merveilles qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} accomplit en faveur des {{gender:humains|hommes}}.
fr.R: Qu’ils remercient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle et pour les choses étonnantes qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait pour les gens.

sw.L: Na wamshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [kwa] upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma, \q na [kwa] maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa wana wa Adamu.
sw.B: Na wamshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma \q na kwa maajabu anayowatendea wanadamu.
sw.R: Wanapaswa kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma \q na kwa mambo ya ajabu anayowafanyia watu.

es.L: Que den gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} [por] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal, y [por] {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} maravillas para con los hijos de la humanidad.
es.B: Que den gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel y por las maravillas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace por la humanidad.
es.R: Deben dar gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel y por las cosas asombrosas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace por la gente.

vi.L: Nguyện họ cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [vì] tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và [vì] những việc kỳ diệu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho con cái loài người.
vi.B: Hãy để họ cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và vì những việc kỳ diệu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho loài người.
vi.R: Họ nên cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vì tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q và vì những điều tuyệt vời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho con người.

ko.L: 그들이 그분의 한결같은 사랑과 사람의 자녀들에게 [행하신] \q 그분의 놀라운 일들로 인해 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하게 하여라.
ko.B: 그들이 그분의 한결같은 사랑과 사람들을 위해 행하신 놀라운 일들로 \q 인해 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하게 하여라.
ko.R: 그들은 그분의 변함없는 사랑과 사람들을 위해 하신 놀라운 일들 때문에 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사해야 한다.

pt.L: Que rendam graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} [pelo] {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal e [pelas] {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} maravilhas para com os filhos da humanidade.
pt.B: Que rendam graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} pelo {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal e pelas {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} maravilhas em favor da humanidade.
pt.R: Que eles agradeçam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} pelo {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor fiel e pelas coisas maravilhosas que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faz pelas pessoas.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ስለ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ፣ \q ለሰው ልጆችም [ስላደረጋቸው] ድንቅ ሥራዎቹ ያመስግኑት።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ስለ ጽኑ ፍቅሩና ለሰው ልጆች \q ስለሚያደርጋቸው ድንቅ ሥራዎች ያመስግኑት።
am.R: ስለ ጽኑ ፍቅሩና ለሰዎች ስለሚያደርጋቸው አስደናቂ ነገሮች {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ማመስገን አለባቸው።

hi.L: वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का उनके अटल प्रेम [के लिए] धन्यवाद करें, और मनुष्य की सन्तान के लिए [किए गए] उनके आश्चर्यकर्मों [के लिए]।
hi.B: वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के अटल प्रेम के लिए और उन आश्चर्यकर्मों के लिए जो वे मनुष्यों के लिए करते हैं, उनका धन्यवाद करें।
hi.R: उन्हें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के अटल प्रेम के लिए और उन अद्भुत कामों के लिए जो वे लोगों के लिए करते हैं, उनका धन्यवाद करना चाहिए।

ru.L: Пусть благодарят {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} за {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменную любовь и за {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} чудеса для детей человеческих.
ru.B: Пусть благодарят {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} за {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменную любовь и за чудеса, которые {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} творит для людей.
ru.R: Пусть они благодарят {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} за {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменную любовь и за удивительные дела, которые {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} делает для людей.

ja.L: 彼らが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に、その誠実を感謝し、人の子らへのその奇しいみわざを[感謝する]ように。
ja.B: その変わらぬいつくしみのゆえに、また人々のために行われる不思議なみわざのゆえに、彼らが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に感謝するように。
ja.R: その変わらぬいつくしみと、人々のためにしてくださる驚くべきことのために、彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に感謝すべきだ。

uk.L: Нехай дякують {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} [за] {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінну любов і [за] {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} чудеса для людських дітей.
uk.B: Нехай віддають {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} подяку за {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінну любов і за чудеса, які {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} чинить для людей.
uk.R: Вони мають дякувати {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} за {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} вірну любов і за дивовижні речі, які {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} робить для людей.

decisions.choice: the second refrain
decisions.reason: This verse comes four times, word for word (8, 15, 21, 31), after each rescue. Those who were rescued are called to give the thanks of verse 1.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith, God's commitment to his people that does not give up (5:8).

decisions.choice: wonders: deeds beyond human power
decisions.reason: The word (nifla'ot) is used of God's acts in Egypt and the wilderness (78:4; 106:22).

decisions.choice: to the children of humankind: done for people
decisions.reason: The wonders are done for human beings, and are seen by them. "Children of humankind" (bene 'adam) means people in general.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

decisions.choice: "les enfants des humains" (Literal) and "les humains" (Balanced) under the gender setting, with "les fils des hommes" and "les hommes" as the alternative
alternatives: no setting, as the English "humankind" needs none
decisions.reason: English "humankind" is already inclusive; French has to choose between an inclusive noun and the traditional "hommes", so the noun carries the setting. Readable says "les gens" and needs none.

decisions.choice: "wana wa Adamu" (children of Adam) at Literal; "wanadamu" (human beings) at Balanced; "watu" (people) at Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "children of humankind", using the word *adam*. "Wana wa Adamu" keeps the picture at Literal, as the English Literal does; "wanadamu" is the ordinary Swahili word built from the same name, so Balanced loses nothing of the sense.

decisions.choice: los hijos de la humanidad (L); la humanidad (B); la gente (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "sons of adam" means human beings. Literal keeps the picture of children with "los hijos de la humanidad", as the English Literal says "children of humankind"; Balanced and Readable say "la humanidad" and "la gente". The refrain keeps this wording each time.

decisions.choice: "con cái loài người" (L), "loài người" (B), "con người" (R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: The Vietnamese words already take in men and women alike, so there is nothing for the gender setting to change. The refrain has the same words in verses 15, 21 and 31. |

decisions.choice: The call "let them give thanks" is "감사하게 하여라" (L, B) and "감사해야 한다" (R); the four refrains (verses 8, 15, 21, 31) are word for word the same
decisions.reason: Korean has no third-person command; "-하게 하여라" (let them) keeps the call, as the Hebrew does, and Readable says "should" as the English Readable does. The archaic "-할지어다" is avoided (style guide section 1).

decisions.choice: Que rendam graças ao SENHOR pelo seu amor leal e pelas suas maravilhas (L, B); Que eles agradeçam ... pelo seu amor fiel (R)
decisions.reason: The second refrain (m1) is repeated word for word in verses 8, 15, 21 and 31, with the verb of verse 1 ("render graças", "agradecer" at Readable) so that the rescued give the thanks the psalm opened with. "Que ..." is the Portuguese wish for the third person; Readable says "amor fiel" (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: os filhos da humanidade (L); a humanidade (B)
decisions.reason: "Children of humankind" (m4) means people in general, so the Portuguese says it without "homens", and with no gender setting, as the English has none here.

decisions.choice: The second refrain (8, 15, 21, 31) has one wording at each level
decisions.reason: Amharic puts the verb last, so "let them give thanks" ("ያመስግኑት") closes the line, after both reasons for thanks.

decisions.choice: आश्चर्यकर्म (L, B); अद्भुत काम (R); one wording for the refrain (verses 8, 15, 21, 31)
decisions.reason: Wonders are deeds beyond human power (m3); Readable uses the everyday phrase. The second refrain has the same Hindi each time it comes back.

decisions.choice: для детей человеческих
decisions.reason: The phrase means human beings in general; "дети человеческие" keeps the Hebrew picture without making it men only. Balanced and Readable say "для людей".

decisions.choice: неизменная любовь
decisions.reason: The poetry note's word for God's hesed at every level, where the English Readable says "faithful love".

decisions.choice: Second refrain (107:8, 15, 21, 31) word for word each time: yodu "感謝するように" (L, B), "感謝すべきだ" (R); nifle'otaw "奇しいみわざ" (L), "不思議なみわざ" (B), "驚くべきこと" (R)
decisions.reason: A third-person wish (let them give thanks), not a command to the hearer, so 〜ように (L, B) and R 'should' 〜べきだ as the English R. The wonders are deeds beyond human power (m3), in the Psalter's forms for nifla'ot (1CH 16:9); bene adam 人の子ら (L), 人々 (B, R).

source.text: כִּי־הִ֭שְׂבִּיעַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׁקֵקָ֑ה וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ רְ֝עֵבָה מִלֵּא־טֽוֹב׃

records.literal_gloss: For he has satisfied [the] longing soul, and [the] hungry soul he has filled [with] good.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has satisfied the longing soul, and the hungry soul {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has filled [with] good.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gives drink to those who are parched and fills the starving with good food.
en.R: He gives water to thirsty people, and good food to people who are hungry.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rassasié l’âme avide, et l’âme affamée, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a comblée de bien.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} donne à boire à ceux qui ont soif et comble de bonne nourriture ceux qui ont faim.
fr.R: Il donne de l’eau aux gens qui ont soif et de la bonne nourriture à ceux qui ont faim.

sw.L: Kwa maana ameishibisha nafsi yenye shauku, \q na nafsi yenye njaa ameijaza mema.
sw.B: Kwa maana huwapa maji wenye kiu \q na kuwashibisha wenye njaa kwa chakula kizuri.
sw.R: Huwapa maji watu wenye kiu, \q na chakula kizuri watu wenye njaa.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha saciado el alma anhelante, y el alma hambrienta {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} la ha llenado [de] bien.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} da de beber a los sedientos y llena de buena comida a los hambrientos.
es.R: Él da agua a las personas que tienen sed, y buena comida a las que tienen hambre.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm thỏa mãn linh hồn khao khát, \q và linh hồn đói khát {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho đầy [điều] tốt lành.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho người khô cổ được uống \q và cho người đói lả được no thức ăn ngon.
vi.R: Ngài cho người khát được uống nước, \q và cho người đói được ăn thức ăn ngon.

ko.L: 참으로 그분께서 애타는 목숨을 만족하게 하시고, \q 주린 목숨을 좋은 것으로 채우셨다.
ko.B: 그분께서는 목마른 이들에게 물을 주시고, \q 굶주린 이들을 좋은 음식으로 채워 주신다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 목마른 사람들에게 물을 주시고, \q 배고픈 사람들에게 좋은 음식을 주신다.

pt.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} saciou a alma sedenta, e a alma faminta {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} encheu de bem.
pt.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} dá de beber a quem tem sede e enche de coisas boas o faminto.
pt.R: Ele dá água às pessoas que têm sede e boa comida às pessoas que têm fome.

am.L: የተጠማችውን ነፍስ አጥግቧልና፤ \q የተራበችውንም ነፍስ በመልካም [ነገር] ሞልቷል።
am.B: የተጠሙትን ያረካልና፤ \q የተራቡትንም በመልካም ምግብ ያጠግባል።
am.R: ለተጠሙ ሰዎች ውኃ ይሰጣል፤ \q ለተራቡትም መልካም ምግብ ይሰጣል።

hi.L: क्योंकि उन्होंने लालायित प्राण को तृप्त किया है, और भूखे प्राण को भलाई से भर दिया है।
hi.B: क्योंकि वे प्यास से सूखे लोगों को पानी पिलाते हैं और भूखों को अच्छे भोजन से तृप्त करते हैं।
hi.R: वे प्यासे लोगों को पानी देते हैं, और भूखे लोगों को अच्छा भोजन देते हैं।

ru.L: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} насытил жаждущую душу, и голодную душу {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} наполнил благом.
ru.B: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} поит томимых жаждой и насыщает голодных доброй пищей.
ru.R: Он даёт воду тем, кто хочет пить, и хорошую еду тем, кто голоден.

ja.L: まことに、その方は渇いた魂を満ち足らせ、飢えた魂を良いもので満たされた。
ja.B: その方は、渇いている者に飲ませ、飢えている者を良いもので満たしてくださる。
ja.R: その方は、のどが渇いた人に水を与え、おなかをすかせた人に良い食べ物を与えてくださる。

uk.L: Бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} наситив спраглу душу, і голодну душу {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} наповнив добром.
uk.B: Бо {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} напуває спраглих і наповнює голодних добрим.
uk.R: Він дає воду спраглим людям і добру їжу голодним.

decisions.choice: soul: throat, appetite
decisions.reason: The word (nefesh) can mean the throat and so the appetite; with "longing" and "hungry" it is the self that thirsts and hungers.

decisions.choice: longing: thirsting
decisions.reason: The word (shoqeqah) describes restless desire, here most likely thirst after the "thirsty" of verse 5 (Isaiah 29:8).

decisions.choice: filled with good: Mary's song
decisions.reason: Mary's song takes up these words: "he has filled the hungry with good things" (Luke 1:53).

decisions.choice: those who are parched, the starving (B); thirsty people, people who are hungry (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable speak of the people themselves (m1).

decisions.choice: gives water
decisions.reason: Readable says what satisfying a thirsty soul means (m2).

decisions.choice: "l'âme" at Literal, where nefesh means throat or appetite
decisions.reason: Here nefesh is the throat that thirsts and the appetite that hungers (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps "âme", as the English Literal keeps "soul" and as French "âme avide" can bear; Balanced and Readable follow the sense and speak of thirst and hunger.

decisions.choice: "người khô cổ", "người đói lả" (B), "người khát", "người đói" (R) for nefesh as throat and appetite
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads nefesh here as the thirsty throat and the hungry appetite; Literal keeps the terms note's "linh hồn", the other levels follow the sense. |

decisions.choice: nefesh as throat/appetite "魂" (L), the people themselves "渇いている者 / 飢えている者" (B, R); "良いもので満たす" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Soul here is throat or appetite (m1); L keeps 魂 as elsewhere, B and R name the people as the English. 良いもので満ち足らせ / 満たす echoes Mary's song (m3), as LUK 1:53's Japanese has it.

source.text: יֹ֭שְׁבֵי חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת אֲסִירֵ֖י עֳנִ֣י וּבַרְזֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Those who sat [in] darkness and deep darkness, prisoners of affliction and iron,

en.L: Those who sat in darkness and deep darkness, prisoners [in] affliction and iron,
en.B: Some lived in darkness, in the blackest gloom, held fast in misery and iron,
en.R: Some people were sitting in darkness, in the deepest gloom. They were prisoners, held in iron chains and in misery.

fr.L: Ceux qui étaient assis [dans] les ténèbres et l’ombre épaisse, prisonniers de la misère et du fer,
fr.B: Certains vivaient dans les ténèbres, dans la plus noire obscurité, captifs de la misère et du fer,
fr.R: Des gens étaient assis dans le noir, dans l’obscurité la plus profonde. Ils étaient prisonniers, attachés avec des chaînes de fer, dans la misère.

sw.L: Wale walioketi katika giza na giza nene, \q wafungwa [katika] mateso na chuma,
sw.B: Wengine waliishi gizani, katika giza nene kabisa, \q wakiwa wamefungwa katika dhiki na minyororo ya chuma,
sw.R: Watu wengine walikuwa wameketi gizani, katika giza zito kabisa. \q Walikuwa wafungwa, wamefungwa kwa minyororo ya chuma na wakiwa katika dhiki.

es.L: Los que moraban en tinieblas y sombra de muerte, prisioneros [en] aflicción y hierros,
es.B: Algunos vivían en tinieblas, en la oscuridad más negra, atrapados en la miseria y en el hierro,
es.R: Algunos estaban sentados en la oscuridad, en la tiniebla más profunda. Eran prisioneros, sujetos con cadenas de hierro y hundidos en la miseria.

vi.L: Những người ngồi trong bóng tối và bóng tối dày đặc, \q những tù nhân trong khốn khổ và xiềng sắt,
vi.B: Có những người sống trong bóng tối, trong cảnh tối tăm mù mịt nhất, \q bị trói buộc trong khốn khổ và xiềng sắt,
vi.R: Có những người ngồi trong bóng tối, trong cảnh tối tăm nhất. \q Họ là tù nhân, bị xiềng bằng xích sắt và sống trong khốn khổ.

ko.L: 어둠과 짙은 어둠 속에 앉은 이들, \q 고난과 쇠에 갇힌 자들이 [있었다].
ko.B: 어떤 이들은 어둠 속에, 가장 짙은 어둠 속에 살았으니, \q 고통과 쇠사슬에 단단히 묶여 있었다.
ko.R: 어떤 사람들은 어둠 속에, 아주 깊은 어둠 속에 앉아 있었다. \q 그들은 쇠사슬에 묶여 비참하게 지내는 죄수들이었다.

pt.L: Os que estavam sentados em trevas e em sombra de morte, presos em aflição e ferro,
pt.B: Uns viviam nas trevas, na escuridão mais negra, presos na miséria e no ferro,
pt.R: Algumas pessoas estavam sentadas no escuro, na escuridão mais profunda. Eram prisioneiros, presos com correntes de ferro e cheios de sofrimento.

am.L: በጨለማና በድቅድቅ ጨለማ የተቀመጡ፣ \q በመከራና በብረት የታሰሩ፣
am.B: አንዳንዶቹ በጨለማ፣ በድቅድቅ ጨለማ ውስጥ ይኖሩ ነበር፤ \q በጉስቁልናና በብረት ተይዘው ነበር፤
am.R: አንዳንድ ሰዎች በጨለማ፣ በድቅድቅ ጨለማ ውስጥ ተቀምጠው ነበር። \q በብረት ሰንሰለትና በሥቃይ የታሰሩ እስረኞች ነበሩ።

hi.L: जो अंधकार और घोर अंधकार में बैठे थे, दुःख और लोहे के बंदी,
hi.B: कुछ लोग अंधकार में, घोर अंधेरे में रहते थे, दुःख और लोहे में जकड़े हुए,
hi.R: कुछ लोग अंधेरे में, गहरे अंधेरे में बैठे थे। वे बंदी थे, लोहे की ज़ंजीरों और दुःख में जकड़े हुए।

ru.L: Сидевшие во тьме и мраке, узники страдания и железа,
ru.B: Другие жили во тьме, в непроглядном мраке, скованные горем и железом,
ru.R: Другие сидели во тьме, в самом глубоком мраке. Они были узниками в железных цепях и в горе.

ja.L: 闇と深い闇の中に座す者たち、苦しみと鉄に縛られた捕らわれ人たち[がいた]。
ja.B: ある者たちは闇の中、真っ暗な闇の中に住み、苦しみと鉄のかせに縛られていた。
ja.R: ある人たちは、闇の中、真っ暗な中に座っていた。彼らは捕らわれ人で、鉄の鎖につながれ、苦しんでいた。

uk.L: Ті, що сиділи в темряві й смертній тіні, вʼязні в стражданні й залізі,
uk.B: Одні жили в темряві, у найчорнішому мороці, скуті горем і залізом,
uk.R: Деякі люди сиділи в темряві, у найглибшому мороці. Вони були вʼязнями, закутими в залізні кайдани й у горе.

decisions.choice: the second picture: prisoners
decisions.reason: The second group sits in a dark prison (verses 10-16). Exile was often pictured as prison (Isaiah 42:7; 49:9).

decisions.choice: deep darkness
decisions.reason: As in 23:4 (tsalmavet): deep, deadly darkness. The same words come again in verse 14.

decisions.choice: affliction and iron: painful chains
decisions.reason: The two words make one picture: the misery of being bound in iron (105:18).

decisions.choice: Some
decisions.reason: As in verse 4, Balanced and Readable mark the start of a new group.

decisions.choice: iron chains
decisions.reason: Readable says what the iron is.

decisions.choice: sombra de morte
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of deadly darkness (m2) as "sombra de morte", the words Portuguese readers know from 23:4; Balanced and Readable say "escuridão mais negra", "mais profunda", as the English does. The same words come back in verse 14.

decisions.choice: deep darkness (tsalmawet) as "ድቅድቅ ጨለማ"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as the deepest darkness of the prison; "የሞት ጥላ" (shadow of death) follows the old reading of the word and would add a meaning the line does not need here.

decisions.choice: Другие
decisions.reason: The second, third and fourth pictures open with "Другие" after "Одни" in verse 4, as Russian lists groups.

decisions.choice: мрак
decisions.reason: The word is the darkest gloom; "мрак" says it without the traditional "тень смерти", which the meaning decision does not require.

decisions.choice: tsalmavet "深い闇" (L), "真っ暗な闇" (B), "真っ暗な中" (R); barzel "鉄" (L), "鉄のかせ" (B), "鉄の鎖" (R)
decisions.reason: Deep darkness (m2), as the Psalter renders tsalmavet by context (23:4); affliction and iron are painful chains (m3). The run-on 107:10-11 is closed at each verse (word order).

source.text: כִּֽי־הִמְר֥וּ אִמְרֵי־אֵ֑ל וַעֲצַ֖ת עֶלְי֣וֹן נָאָֽצוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: for they had rebelled against [the] words of God, and [the] counsel of [the] Most High they had spurned.

en.L: for they had rebelled against the words of God, and the counsel of the Most High they had spurned.
en.B: because they had defied what God said and scorned the purpose of the Most High.
en.R: This happened because they had turned against what God said. They had refused to listen to the advice of the God who is above all.

fr.L: car ils s’étaient rebellés contre les paroles de Dieu, et le conseil du Très-Haut, ils l’avaient méprisé.
fr.B: parce qu’ils avaient défié ce que Dieu avait dit et dédaigné le dessein du Très-Haut.
fr.R: Cela leur était arrivé parce qu’ils s’étaient tournés contre ce que Dieu avait dit. Ils avaient refusé d’écouter les conseils du Dieu qui est au-dessus de tout.

sw.L: kwa maana walikuwa wameyaasi maneno ya Mungu, \q na shauri la Aliye Juu Kabisa walikuwa wamelidharau.
sw.B: kwa sababu walikuwa wamepinga yale aliyosema Mungu \q na kudharau kusudi la Aliye Juu Kabisa.
sw.R: Hayo yaliwapata kwa sababu walikuwa wamekataa yale aliyosema Mungu. \q Walikuwa wamekataa kusikiliza ushauri wa Mungu aliye juu ya wote.

es.L: porque se habían rebelado contra las palabras de Dios, y el consejo del Altísimo habían despreciado.
es.B: porque habían desafiado lo que Dios dijo y despreciado los planes del Altísimo.
es.R: Esto pasó porque se habían vuelto contra lo que Dios dijo. Se habían negado a escuchar los consejos del Dios que está por encima de todo.

vi.L: vì họ đã chống nghịch những lời của Đức Chúa Trời, \q và sự chỉ dẫn của Đấng Chí Cao họ đã khinh bỏ.
vi.B: vì họ đã chống lại lời Đức Chúa Trời phán \q và coi thường ý định của Đấng Chí Cao.
vi.R: Việc ấy xảy ra vì họ đã chống lại điều Đức Chúa Trời phán. \q Họ không chịu nghe lời khuyên của Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng cao hơn mọi sự.

ko.L: 그들이 하나님의 말씀들을 거역하였고, \q 지극히 높으신 분의 뜻을 업신여겼기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그들이 하나님의 말씀을 거스르고 \q 지극히 높으신 분의 뜻을 멸시했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그들이 하나님의 말씀을 거역했기 때문이다. \q 그들은 모든 것 위에 계신 하나님의 충고를 듣지 않았다.

pt.L: porque se rebelaram contra as palavras de Deus, e o conselho do Altíssimo desprezaram.
pt.B: porque desafiaram o que Deus disse e desprezaram o plano do Altíssimo.
pt.R: Isso aconteceu porque eles tinham se voltado contra o que Deus disse. Tinham se recusado a ouvir os conselhos do Deus que está acima de tudo.

am.L: የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ዐምፀዋልና፤ \q የልዑልንም ምክር ንቀዋልና።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር የተናገረውን ተቃውመው፣ \q የልዑልንም ዓላማ ንቀው ነበርና።
am.R: ይህ የሆነው እግዚአብሔር የተናገረውን ስለ ተቃወሙ ነው። \q ከሁሉ በላይ የሆነው አምላክ የሰጣቸውን ምክር ለመስማት እምቢ ብለው ነበር።

hi.L: क्योंकि उन्होंने परमेश्वर के वचनों से विद्रोह किया था, और परमप्रधान की सम्मति को तुच्छ जाना था।
hi.B: क्योंकि उन्होंने परमेश्वर की बात की अवहेलना की थी और परमप्रधान की योजना को ठुकरा दिया था।
hi.R: ऐसा इसलिए हुआ क्योंकि वे परमेश्वर की बात के विरुद्ध हो गए थे। उन्होंने उस परमेश्वर की सलाह सुनने से इनकार किया था जो सबसे ऊपर हैं।

ru.L: потому что они восстали против слов Божьих, и совет Всевышнего они отвергли.
ru.B: потому что они противились тому, что сказал Бог, и пренебрегли замыслом Всевышнего.
ru.R: Так случилось, потому что они пошли против того, что сказал Бог. Они не захотели слушать совета Бога, который выше всех.

ja.L: 彼らが神の言葉に逆らい、いと高き方の計らいを侮ったからである。
ja.B: 彼らが神の言われたことに逆らい、いと高き方のご計画を軽んじたからである。
ja.R: こうなったのは、彼らが神の言われたことに背いたからだ。彼らは、すべてのものの上におられる神の勧めに、耳を貸そうとしなかった。

uk.L: бо вони збунтувалися проти слів Бога, і задумом Всевишнього вони знехтували.
uk.B: бо вони опиралися тому, що сказав Бог, і зневажили задум Всевишнього.
uk.R: Це сталося, бо вони повстали проти того, що сказав Бог. Вони не захотіли слухати поради Бога, який вищий за все.

decisions.choice: trouble that came from rebellion
decisions.reason: Unlike the travelers, these prisoners brought their trouble on themselves by turning from God's word. Even so, when they cry out, he sets them free (verse 13).

decisions.choice: counsel: plan, advice
decisions.reason: The word ('etsah) is advice given, or the plan God has made (33:11).

decisions.choice: the Most High: God above all
decisions.reason: The title ('Elyon) names God as the highest over all (7:18; 46:5).

decisions.choice: the God who is above all
decisions.reason: Readable says what the title means.

decisions.choice: This happened
decisions.reason: Readable begins a new sentence and links it to verse 10.

decisions.choice: "Đấng Chí Cao" (L, B); "Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng cao hơn mọi sự" (R), as Psalm 46:5
decisions.reason: The earlier Psalms set these forms for the Most High. |

decisions.choice: "the words of God" (El) as "የእግዚአብሔር ቃል"; the Most High as "ልዑል" (R "ከሁሉ በላይ የሆነው አምላክ", as 57:3)
decisions.reason: El stands alone for the one God, with no possessor, so it is "እግዚአብሔር" with no divine_name span (the span is only for YHWH).

decisions.choice: 'atsat 'Elyon "いと高き方の計らい" (L), "いと高き方のご計画" (B), "すべてのものの上におられる神の勧め" (R)
decisions.reason: Counsel is plan or advice (m2); 'Elyon in the Psalter's forms (L, B いと高き方, R すべてのものの上におられる神). marah 逆らう (L, B), 背く (R).

source.text: וַיַּכְנַ֣ע בֶּעָמָ֣ל לִבָּ֑ם כָּ֝שְׁל֗וּ וְאֵ֣ין עֹזֵֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he humbled with toil their heart; they stumbled, and there was no helper.

en.L: So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} humbled their heart with toil; they stumbled, and [there was] no one to help.
en.B: So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} broke their pride with hard labor; they fell, and no one came to help.
en.R: So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} humbled them with hard work. They fell down, and no one helped them.

fr.L: Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a humilié leur cœur par la peine ; ils ont trébuché, et [il n’y avait] personne pour aider.
fr.B: Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a brisé leur orgueil par un dur travail ; ils sont tombés, et personne n’est venu les aider.
fr.R: Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a rendus humbles par un travail pénible. Ils sont tombés, et personne ne les a aidés.

sw.L: Basi aliinyenyekeza mioyo yao kwa taabu; \q walijikwaa, wala hapakuwa na msaidizi.
sw.B: Basi akakivunja kiburi chao kwa kazi ngumu; \q walianguka, wala hakuna aliyekuja kuwasaidia.
sw.R: Basi aliwanyenyekeza kwa kazi ngumu. \q Walianguka, wala hakuna aliyewasaidia.

es.L: Por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} humilló su corazón con trabajos; tropezaron, y no [hubo] quien ayudara.
es.B: Así que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quebró su orgullo con trabajos duros; cayeron, y nadie vino a ayudarlos.
es.R: Así que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los humilló con trabajos pesados. Se cayeron, y nadie los ayudó.

vi.L: Vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hạ lòng họ xuống bằng lao khổ; \q họ vấp ngã, và không [có ai] giúp đỡ.
vi.B: Vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bẻ gãy lòng kiêu ngạo của họ bằng lao dịch nặng nhọc; \q họ ngã xuống, và không ai đến giúp.
vi.R: Vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hạ họ xuống bằng công việc nặng nhọc. \q Họ ngã xuống, và không ai giúp họ.

ko.L: 그래서 그분께서 고역으로 그들의 마음을 낮추셨으니, \q 그들이 넘어졌으나 돕는 이가 [없었다].
ko.B: 그래서 그분께서는 고된 노동으로 그들의 교만을 꺾으셨다. \q 그들이 쓰러졌으나 아무도 도우러 오지 않았다.
ko.R: 그래서 그분께서는 힘든 일로 그들을 낮추셨다. \q 그들이 넘어졌지만 아무도 그들을 돕지 않았다.

pt.L: Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} abateu o coração deles com fadiga; tropeçaram, e não [havia] quem ajudasse.
pt.B: Por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} quebrou o orgulho deles com trabalhos pesados; caíram, e ninguém veio ajudar.
pt.R: Por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os fez humildes com trabalho duro. Eles caíram, e ninguém os ajudou.

am.L: ስለዚህ ልባቸውን በድካም አዋረደ፤ \q ተሰናከሉ፤ የሚረዳም አልነበረም።
am.B: ስለዚህ በከባድ ድካም ትዕቢታቸውን ሰበረ፤ \q ወደቁ፤ የሚረዳቸውም አልመጣም።
am.R: ስለዚህ በከባድ ሥራ አዋረዳቸው። \q ወደቁ፤ ማንም አልረዳቸውም።

hi.L: इसलिए उन्होंने परिश्रम से उनके हृदय को नम्र किया; वे लड़खड़ाए, और कोई सहायक न [था]।
hi.B: इसलिए उन्होंने कठोर परिश्रम से उनका घमंड तोड़ दिया; वे गिर पड़े, और कोई सहायता करने न आया।
hi.R: इसलिए उन्होंने कड़ी मेहनत से उन्हें नीचा किया। वे गिर पड़े, और किसी ने उनकी सहायता न की।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} смирил тяжким трудом их сердце; они споткнулись, и не [было] помогающего.
ru.B: И {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сломил их гордость тяжким трудом; они падали, и никто не пришёл на помощь.
ru.R: Тогда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} смирил их тяжёлой работой. Они падали, и никто им не помог.

ja.L: それで、その方は苦役によって彼らの心を低くなさった。彼らはつまずき、助ける者はいなかった。
ja.B: そこで、その方は厳しい労苦によって彼らの高ぶりを打ち砕かれた。彼らは倒れたが、助けに来る者はいなかった。
ja.R: それで、その方は、つらい仕事によって彼らを低くなさった。彼らは倒れたが、だれも助けてくれなかった。

uk.L: Тож {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} упокорив їхнє серце тяжкою працею; вони спіткнулися, і [не було] нікого, хто допоміг би.
uk.B: Тож {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} зламав їхню гордість тяжкою працею; вони падали, і ніхто не прийшов на допомогу.
uk.R: Тож {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} упокорив їх тяжкою працею. Вони падали, і ніхто їм не допомагав.

decisions.choice: toil: hard, painful labor
decisions.reason: The word ('amal) is hard work and the misery it brings, here the forced labor of prisoners.

decisions.choice: humbled their heart: brought down their pride
decisions.reason: The heart is the inner self; to bring it low is to break the pride that rebelled (verse 11).

decisions.choice: broke their pride
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the idiom means (m2).

decisions.choice: hikhnia' "低くなさった" rather than "低くされた"
decisions.reason: 低くされた could be read as a passive ('they were brought low'); the お〜になる / なさる form keeps God as the one who acts (PSA-1 conventions).

source.text: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻֽקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they cried out to YHWH in the distress [that was] to them; from their troubles he saved them.

en.L: Then they cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in their distress; from their troubles {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saved them.
en.B: In their distress they called out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saved them from their troubles.
en.R: In their trouble they cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saved them from their suffering.

fr.L: Alors ils ont crié {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} dans leur détresse ; de leurs angoisses {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a sauvés.
fr.B: Dans leur détresse, ils ont appelé {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au secours, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a sauvés de leurs angoisses.
fr.R: Dans leur malheur, ils ont crié {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les aide, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a sauvés de leurs souffrances.

sw.L: Ndipo wakamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika dhiki yao; \q kutoka katika taabu zao akawaokoa.
sw.B: Katika dhiki yao walimlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akawaokoa katika taabu zao.
sw.R: Katika taabu yao walimlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awasaidie, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akawaokoa katika mateso yao.

es.L: Entonces clamaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en su angustia; de sus aflicciones {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los salvó.
es.B: En su angustia clamaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los salvó de sus aflicciones.
es.R: En su aflicción clamaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} pidiendo ayuda, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los salvó de su sufrimiento.

vi.L: Bấy giờ họ kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong cơn khốn quẫn của họ; \q khỏi những nỗi gian nan của họ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cứu họ.
vi.B: Trong cơn khốn quẫn, họ kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứu họ khỏi những nỗi gian nan.
vi.R: Trong lúc khốn khó, họ kêu cứu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cứu họ khỏi cảnh khổ.

ko.L: 그때에 그들이 고난 가운데서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖으니, \q 그분께서 그들의 곤경에서 그들을 구원하셨다.
ko.B: 그들이 고난 가운데서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖자, \q 그분께서 곤경에서 그들을 구원해 주셨다.
ko.R: 괴로울 때 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 도와 달라고 부르짖자, \q 그분께서 고통에서 그들을 구원해 주셨다.

pt.L: Então clamaram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} na sua angústia; das suas aflições {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os salvou.
pt.B: Na sua angústia clamaram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os salvou das suas aflições.
pt.R: No meio da aflição, eles clamaram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} pedindo socorro, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os salvou do sofrimento.

am.L: በጭንቀታቸውም ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጮኹ፤ \q ከመከራቸውም አዳናቸው።
am.B: በጭንቀታቸው ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ተጣሩ፤ \q እርሱም ከመከራቸው አዳናቸው።
am.R: በችግራቸው ጊዜ እርዳታ ለማግኘት ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጮኹ፤ \q እርሱም ከሥቃያቸው አዳናቸው።

hi.L: तब उन्होंने अपने संकट में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की दोहाई दी; उनकी विपत्तियों से उन्होंने उन्हें बचाया।
hi.B: अपने संकट में उन्होंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को पुकारा, और उन्होंने उन्हें उनकी विपत्तियों से बचा लिया।
hi.R: अपनी मुसीबत में उन्होंने सहायता के लिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को पुकारा, और उन्होंने उन्हें उनके दुःखों से बचा लिया।

ru.L: Тогда они воззвали к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} в своей беде; из их бедствий {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} спас их.
ru.B: В беде они воззвали к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} спас их от бедствий.
ru.R: В беде они стали звать {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} на помощь, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} спас их от страданий.

ja.L: そのとき彼らは、自分たちの苦難の中で{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に叫び求めた。その方は彼らを、その苦悩からお救いになった。
ja.B: 苦難の中で彼らが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に呼び求めると、その方は彼らを苦しみからお救いになった。
ja.R: 困り果てた彼らは、助けを求めて{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に叫んだ。すると、その方は彼らを苦しみから救ってくださった。

uk.L: Тоді вони закликали до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} у своїй скруті; з їхніх бід {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} спас їх.
uk.B: У своїй скруті вони кликали до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} спас їх з їхніх бід.
uk.R: У своїй біді вони кликали {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} на допомогу, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} спас їх від їхніх страждань.

decisions.choice: the first refrain again
decisions.reason: As in verse 6; only the verb of rescue changes.

decisions.choice: cried out: cried for help
decisions.reason: As in verse 6.

decisions.choice: saved: brought to safety
decisions.reason: The verb (yasha', causative) is the common word for saving and rescue; the same verb comes in verse 19.

decisions.choice: in their distress ... from their troubles
alternatives: they cried out ... in their trouble, and he ... them from their distress
decisions.reason: As in verse 6.

source.text: יֽ֭וֹצִיאֵם מֵחֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת וּמוֹסְר֖וֹתֵיהֶ֣ם יְנַתֵּֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: He brought them out from darkness and deep darkness, and their bonds he tore apart.

en.L: He brought them out of darkness and deep darkness, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} tore apart their bonds.
en.B: He led them out of the darkness and the blackest gloom and snapped the chains that held them.
en.R: He led them out of the darkness and the deep gloom. He broke their chains apart.

fr.L: Il les a fait sortir des ténèbres et de l’ombre épaisse, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rompu leurs liens.
fr.B: Il les a fait sortir des ténèbres et de la plus noire obscurité et a brisé les chaînes qui les tenaient.
fr.R: Il les a fait sortir de l’obscurité profonde. Il a cassé leurs chaînes.

sw.L: Aliwatoa katika giza na giza nene, \q akavikata vifungo vyao.
sw.B: Aliwatoa katika giza na giza nene kabisa, \q akaikatakata minyororo iliyowafunga.
sw.R: Aliwaongoza kutoka gizani na katika giza zito. \q Aliivunja minyororo yao.

es.L: Los sacó de las tinieblas y de la sombra de muerte, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} rompió sus ataduras.
es.B: Los sacó de las tinieblas y de la oscuridad más negra, y partió las cadenas que los sujetaban.
es.R: Los sacó de la oscuridad y de la tiniebla profunda. Rompió sus cadenas.

vi.L: Ngài đã đem họ ra khỏi bóng tối và bóng tối dày đặc, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã bứt đứt xiềng xích của họ.
vi.B: Ngài dẫn họ ra khỏi bóng tối và cảnh tối tăm mù mịt nhất, \q và bẻ gãy xiềng xích trói buộc họ.
vi.R: Ngài dẫn họ ra khỏi bóng tối và cảnh tối tăm. \q Ngài bẻ gãy xiềng xích của họ.

ko.L: 그분께서 그들을 어둠과 짙은 어둠에서 이끌어 내시고, \q 그들의 결박을 끊으셨다.
ko.B: 그분께서 그들을 어둠과 가장 짙은 어둠에서 이끌어 내시고, \q 그들을 묶은 사슬을 끊어 버리셨다.
ko.R: 그분께서 그들을 어둠과 깊은 어둠에서 이끌어 내셨다. \q 그들의 사슬을 끊어 주셨다.

pt.L: Ele os tirou das trevas e da sombra de morte, e as amarras deles {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} despedaçou.
pt.B: Ele os tirou das trevas e da escuridão mais negra e rebentou as correntes que os prendiam.
pt.R: Ele os tirou do escuro e da escuridão profunda. Ele quebrou as correntes deles.

am.L: ከጨለማና ከድቅድቅ ጨለማ አወጣቸው፤ \q እስራታቸውንም በጣጠሰ።
am.B: ከጨለማውና ከድቅድቁ ጨለማ መርቶ አወጣቸው፤ \q ያሰሯቸውንም ሰንሰለቶች በጠሰ።
am.R: ከጨለማውና ከድቅድቁ ጨለማ መርቶ አወጣቸው። \q ሰንሰለታቸውንም ሰባበረ።

hi.L: वे उन्हें अंधकार और घोर अंधकार से निकाल लाए, और उनके बंधन तोड़ डाले।
hi.B: वे उन्हें अंधकार और घोर अंधेरे से बाहर ले आए और उनकी जकड़नेवाली ज़ंजीरें तोड़ डालीं।
hi.R: वे उन्हें अंधेरे और गहरे अंधेरे से बाहर ले आए। उन्होंने उनकी ज़ंजीरें तोड़ डालीं।

ru.L: Он вывел их из тьмы и мрака, и узы их {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} разорвал.
ru.B: Он вывел их из тьмы и непроглядного мрака и разорвал цепи, которые держали их.
ru.R: Он вывел их из тьмы и глубокого мрака. Он разорвал их цепи.

ja.L: その方は彼らを闇と深い闇から連れ出し、彼らの縄目を断ち切られた。
ja.B: その方は彼らを闇から、真っ暗な闇から導き出し、彼らを縛っていた鎖を断ち切られた。
ja.R: その方は彼らを、闇と真っ暗な中から連れ出し、その鎖を断ち切ってくださった。

uk.L: Він вивів їх із темряви й смертної тіні, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} розірвав їхні пута.
uk.B: Він вивів їх із темряви й найчорнішого мороку і розірвав ланцюги, що їх тримали.
uk.R: Він вивів їх із темряви й глибокого мороку. Він розірвав їхні кайдани.

decisions.choice: darkness and deep darkness: the words of verse 10
decisions.reason: The rescue answers the trouble word for word: those who sat in darkness and deep darkness (verse 10) are brought out of it.

decisions.choice: bonds: ropes or fetters
decisions.reason: The word (moserot) is the bands that tie a prisoner or an animal (2:3).

source.text: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Let them give thanks to YHWH [for] his loyal love, and his wonders to [the] children of humankind.

en.L: Let them give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [for] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love, and [for] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wonders to the children of humankind.
en.B: Let them give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} thanks for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love and for the wonders {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} works for humankind.
en.R: They should thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful love and for the amazing things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does for people.

fr.L: Qu’ils rendent grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} [pour] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal, et [pour] {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} merveilles envers les {{gender:enfants des humains|fils des hommes}}.
fr.B: Qu’ils rendent grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle et pour les merveilles qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} accomplit en faveur des {{gender:humains|hommes}}.
fr.R: Qu’ils remercient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle et pour les choses étonnantes qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait pour les gens.

sw.L: Na wamshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [kwa] upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma, \q na [kwa] maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa wana wa Adamu.
sw.B: Na wamshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma \q na kwa maajabu anayowatendea wanadamu.
sw.R: Wanapaswa kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma \q na kwa mambo ya ajabu anayowafanyia watu.
